title: Music to my Ears
description: A mod that lets you play music of your choice in-game!
body:
# Music to my Ears

**A mod that lets you play custom music in-game!**

#### Commands (/mtme):

- queue [song_name/all] -> queue a song/all songs
- queue [song_name] remove -> remove a song
- list -> list all queued songs
- skip -> skip to the next queued song
- stop -> stop the current song and clear the queue

## HOW TO ADD SONGS

#### Windows:

- Press "Win + R"
- Type "%APPDATA%\\.minecraft\config\Music to my Ears\music"
- Press "Enter"
- Drag your music files into that folder

#### macOS:

- Open "Finder"
- Press "Cmd + Shift + G"
- Type "~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/config/Music to my Ears/music"
- Press "Enter"
- Drag your music files into that folder

#### ONLY SUPPORTS .OGG FILES & FILE NAMES MUST BE IN LOWERCASE!

**Additionally, when adding new songs, you DO NOT have to leave the server/re-open minecraft. You can simply add a new song file and play it right away!**
